_comment: The wizard state the checked-in golden is rendered from. It is the ARGUMENT to
`renderPlanBytes`, not a Kubernetes object: every other fixture in this directory is
shaped like something the API server returns, and this one is shaped like the form the
wizard accumulates across its six steps.
Both arms of `render_plan_bytes_emits_a_document_the_runner_parses` read this file.
Arm 2 (node, pages.spec.js) renders it and byte-compares the result with
plan.golden.yaml. Arm 1 (Rust, crates/logweir/tests/ui_lint.rs) deserialises the golden
target.topic_naming.prefix and restore.point_in_time with the three values below --
